summary: Iteration 18 — focused test of the NEW admin-uploadable welcome/advertisement image feature (backend + frontend) plus incidental regression on welcome-text save and broadcast history. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (11 API + 3 bot.reply() unit ordering tests). Frontend: full upload -> preview -> reload-persist -> remove -> reload-persist cycle verified via Playwright on the public preview URL, including non-image rejection and locked/unlocked visibility. No blocking issues found; only 3 minor observations. No live Telegram broadcast was triggered.

minor.issue: No try/except around bot_module.get_broadcast_file(path); if the object-storage fetch fails (or the stored path was garbage-collected) the endpoint will bubble a 500 instead of a clean 404/502. bot.reply() already guards this same call with try/except.

Size cap is enforced only after the whole body is read into memory (await file.read() then len check), so a 10MB+ upload is fully buffered before rejection. Works (verified 400 'Image too large (max 10MB).'), but consider a streaming/Content-Length pre-check.

issues: welcome-image-status auto-clears after 4s via setTimeout for BOTH success and error paths — the red error ('Only image files are allowed.') vanishes on its own, which an admin may miss. Suggest keeping error messages until the next action.

action_items: Optional: wrap get_broadcast_file() in GET /api/welcome-image with try/except and return 404/502 instead of a 500.
Optional UX: do not auto-clear the red error text in welcome-image-status after 4s.
critical_code_review_comments: public_settings() correctly exposes only has_welcome_image and never leaks welcome_image_path/_id/pin_hash — verified by assertion.
PUT /api/settings uses $set on text fields only, so saving welcome text does not clobber welcome_image_path — verified by test_settings_put_does_not_clobber_image.
bot.reply() sends reply_photo() before reply_text() and, on storage failure, still sends the text (graceful degradation) — verified by 3 unit tests with a fake Update.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a 600x300 TEST_ad.png creative during testing and then removed it. Final DB state: has_welcome_image=false, welcome_ta/welcome_en/official_username unchanged from before testing (verified via GET /api/settings). No broadcasts sent.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 246810 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — unlock worked via lock-chip -> pin-input -> unlock-submit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome-image feature is fully verified end-to-end (iteration 18). Backend regression suite for it: /app/backend/tests/test_welcome_image_iter18.py (API, hits the public URL) and test_welcome_image_reply_iter18.py (bot.reply() ordering, monkeypatches bot.get_settings/get_broadcast_file, no network). Note: ConfigPanel's welcome-image-status auto-clears after 4s, so poll for it within ~3s of clicking upload/remove or you will read '(none)'. Also note config-save is correctly disabled when the textareas match the persisted (stripped) server value — do not treat that as a bug. Never trigger a live broadcast in preview (~59 real users).
rca_of_the_issue: No defect found. Two earlier apparent failures were test artifacts: (1) 'upload status (none)' was caused by the intentional 4s auto-clear timer; (2) the second config-save click timing out was because the backend strips trailing whitespace, so restoring the original text left the form non-dirty and the save button correctly disabled.
